tabs.label: Overview
tabs.title: Programmable voice. Wholesale infrastructure. Your choice of providers.
tabs.description: Build voice applications with VoiceML, connect SIP services, and manage messaging and numbers through VoiceTel APIs. Use built-in speech defaults or connect your preferred providers.
tabs.previewTitle: From your application to the phone network
tabs.note: Use built-in speech defaults, or bring your own speech providers and recording storage.

tabs.label: VoiceML
tabs.title: Build call flows with familiar voice markup.
tabs.description: Use XML-based VoiceML to speak to callers, collect keypad input, route calls, and record conversations. Check supported verbs and compatibility details when migrating an existing application.
tabs.note: Your application handles the collected digit at /dispatch and returns the next VoiceML response.

tabs.label: Voice & SIP
tabs.title: Connect your applications and PBX to the phone network.
tabs.description: Connect your SIP infrastructure to VoiceTel for inbound and outbound calling. Use the configuration guides to set up your PBX, gateways, and call routing.
tabs.note: Origination brings calls to your application. Termination connects outbound calls to their destination.

tabs.label: Messaging
tabs.title: Send messages. Handle replies in your application.
tabs.description: Build notifications and two-way messaging with SMS and MMS APIs. Configure inbound delivery to your webhook and manage A2P 10DLC registration for application messaging.
steps: An inbound webhook reaches your application
tabs.note: Illustrative message flow. Delivery depends on registration, destination, and carrier requirements.

tabs.label: Numbers
tabs.title: Provision numbers and manage their routing.
tabs.description: Search number inventory, provision numbers, and configure services through VoiceTel APIs. Bring existing numbers through the porting workflow and manage per-number routing.
steps: Provision a new number or request a port
Manage the number through the API
tabs.note: Porting follows a coordinated cutover process; submitting a request does not immediately move service.

tabs.label: AI Agents
tabs.title: Connect voice and chat agents to your tools and knowledge.
tabs.description: Configure assistants with a model, instructions, tools, and knowledge resources. Connect voice sessions through VoiceML and inspect session history through the API.
tabs.previewTitle: An assistant connected to your application
tabs.note: Available model providers depend on the integrations enabled on your account.
